results.snippet: NI channel 4 (U1-NI-RPS-4A) calibration zero-offset correction performed per SOP-U1-NI-001. As-left zero reading within acceptance band but at upper bound: +0.8% vs acceptance criterion ±1.0%. EMI shielding check recommended — local cabinet area has known electromagnetic interference source from unshielded wiring. Channel 4 has documented noise history consistent with EMI influence. Calibration technically acceptable; recommend engineering evaluation for EMI source removal before next surveillance cycle.

Step 7 — Single-channel trip investigation. If a reactor trip is initiated by a single NI channel and the remaining three channels do not show correlated flux increase, this is indicative of a spurious instrument signal rather than a genuine reactivity excursion. A genuine power excursion at full power would produce simultaneous flux responses on all four measurement channels within 100 milliseconds. Single-channel response without channel correlation should be treated as an instrument fault until proven otherwise. Check for EMI, calibration drift, and prior noise history on the tripping channel.

NI channel 4 has shown elevated noise floor since installation of new control panel in adjacent bay in July 2025. Root cause: inadequate EMI shielding on instrumentation cable run through shared conduit. Corrective action: install ferrite chokes and reroute cable. WO issued; completion deferred to next outage window. Channel 4 noise-induced trip risk is elevated until remediation is complete. As-found channel readings show peak-to-peak noise of approximately 0.8% rated power — consistent with causing a spurious reading at the upper calibration bound.

Post-trip assessment of reactor trip on 2026-03-10. Trip initiated by NI channel 4 only. Channels 1, 2, and 3 show no correlated flux excursion before or during the trip signal. FCV-FW-3301 position deviation 45 seconds before the trip is noted but SG-3 steam generator level and feedwater flow remained within normal limits — the FCV deviation did not produce a detectable reactivity change. CRD-2214 position indicator step change is timestamped 10 seconds after the NI-4 trip signal and is consistent with a rod insertion seating transient, not a rod ejection. Engineering evaluation focused on NI-4 spurious signal cause.
